paras: Application: Toyota 86 / Subaru BRZ / Scion FR-S (2012–2021) and Toyota GR86 / Subaru BRZ (2022+) Part Type: CCV Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0902-FL

The Radium 20-0902-FL catch can kit runs inline with the 1/2in crankcase breather (CCV) port and mounts on the LH side of the engine bay. It separates oil and water condensation from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, keeping the intake, intercooler, throttle body and manifold cleaner and keeping oil vapour out of the cabin. On turbo or supercharged cars with oil build-up in the intercooler it is essential, as oil reduces heat exchanger efficiency.
hl: CCV Circuit: Inline with the 1/2in breather port, LH side of the engine bay
Fluid Lock: Patented Fluid Lock design stops the reservoir overfilling and traps collected fluid until the can is emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
